hints: Rearrange the formula to express eta as the subject.
Note that (rho - sigma) is a difference of two densities, so its unit is simply kg m^-3.
solution: eta = (2 * r^2 * g * (rho - sigma)) / (9 * v). Base units: (m^2)(m s^-2)(kg m^-3) / (m s^-1) = (kg s^-2) / (m s^-1) = kg m^-1 s^-1.
teacher_walkthrough: Make eta the subject: eta = (2/9) * r^2 * g * (rho - sigma) / v.
Numerator units: [r^2] * [g] * [rho - sigma] = (m^2) * (m s^-2) * (kg m^-3) = kg s^-2.
Divide numerator by denominator: (kg s^-2) / (m s^-1) = kg m^-1 s^-1.
